description: Defines the Article class with properties and annotations representing an article entity in the domain model, including relationships to comments, tags, and favorites.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents an article with properties for content, author, comments, tags, favorites, and timestamps, including derived properties for favorites count and tags list.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Indicates whether the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Returns a list of tag identifiers associated with the article.
